notes.title: Timore Redo is out now!
notes.notes:
Timore Redo is out!

It is fully available on Steam, the game features a lot of surrealism, guns, enemies, bosses, 8 voice actors, the story and gameplay mixed together, thanks everyone for your support and please enjoy the new Timore Redo!

Vidas

notes.title: Timore Redo development
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/41ff01283c22138bf3db1d126b36cbe68b3c3a43.png[/img]

Timore Redo

The game is currently still in development, there's a lot to see so I'll be sharing some of the things in this announcement. Expected release date would be some time in Q1 2022, the game will be bigger than other Timore games so far, with more gameplay, combat, stories, everything.

First of multiple weapons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/6f6631b50231b15ba5433a6914440239057d04dd.png[/img]
The weapon seller in Timore Redo, Mr Azure:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/db37220873690e0fbbb3cf2cff47c05bef42264a.gif[/img]
Main characters. Noah, Madison, Isaac, Violet:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/c6bc295ed26f6b4b510df5d871b134a1f198260c.png[/img]

Sneak peek at the boss monsters:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/615ff54700b2b8cf4df60fee1349e8cd55c3d47a.png[/img]

And of course, The Mannequin:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/465b02c9bb08888a3b3242d845c3e481b5dc5c2a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851666/9e9eb972a53ab244c0223a84a801862f42b3d3ba.gif[/img]

Thanks everyone for your support!
